basicDetails.schemeName: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme “Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers” was started by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB), Labour Department, Government of Haryana on 15.01.2019. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- will be provided as Shagun for the marriage of workers&#39; sons and unmarried male workers themselves. The benefit of the schemes will be given to the worker equally as there is a lot of financial pressure on the worker during the worker&#39;s own marriage or the son&#39;s marriage. The financial pressure on the worker will be reduced by giving the amount of Shagun by the board.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
   1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
   1. The monthly salary of the applicant should not exceed ₹25,000/-.
   1. The applicant must have a minimum of three years of regular membership of the Board till the Marriage date.
   1. The applicant should apply within six months after the marriage date.
   1. The benefits are provided to workers for the marriage of up to two sons and for the self-marriage of male workers.

**Note 01:** The workers will give this undertaking in which they will clearly explain to the board about not taking the benefit of the Shagun scheme for the first, second, or third time or never before.
**Note 02:** If a worker wants to avail the benefit of this scheme 03 days before the marriage, then the organization will certify the date of organizing the marriage of the worker&#39;s children or unmarried worker and will keep the necessary documents related to organizing the marriage of the workers in its records. The undertaking will be given that within 06 months after the date of marriage, the managers will present the marriage registration certificate before the Board, and if they do not present the said registration certificate before the Board within six months, then they will have to deposit the amount provided to the worker under the said scheme in the board.
